theme_central: The signs of creation, offered for reflection, culminate in the scene of the Day when every nation will be seen kneeling (jathiya), called to answer for its record of deeds.
sources_note: 4-ruku structure precisely sourced (slideshare.net / grokipedia): signs 2-15, divergence after receiving knowledge, desire taken as a deity, Day of kneeling 27-37.

branches.title: Opening, signs in creation
branches.resume: Revelation of the Book, signs in the heavens, the earth, the night, the day and the sea subdued for man.

children.t: Revelation of the Book, signs for those who have certainty
Alternation of day/night, winds, rain, the sea subdued for man's service

branches.title: Legacy of the Children of Israel, divergence
branches.resume: Book, wisdom and prophethood given to the Children of Israel; divergence appeared after receiving knowledge.

children.t: Legacy given to the Children of Israel, divergence appeared after receiving knowledge

branches.title: Whoever takes his desire as a deity
branches.resume: Warning against whoever follows his own desire as if worshipping it; doubt about the resurrection.

children.t: Whoever takes his own desire as a deity, doubt about the resurrection

branches.title: The Day of kneeling
branches.resume: Source of the surah's name: every nation kneeling, called to its record of deeds; closing on Allah's greatness.

children.t: Every nation kneeling, called to answer for its record
Closing: Allah's greatness in the heavens and on the earth
